WITH "districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT county, district FROM "schools" WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)') AND district IS NOT NULL), "school_administrators" AS (SELECT county, district, cdscode, admfname1 AS "first_name" FROM "schools" WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND school IS NOT NULL AND admfname1 IS NOT NULL AND admfname1 <> '' UNION ALL SELECT county, district, cdscode, admfname2 AS "first_name" FROM "schools" WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND school IS NOT NULL AND admfname2 IS NOT NULL AND admfname2 <> '' UNION ALL SELECT county, district, cdscode, admfname3 AS "first_name" FROM "schools" WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND school IS NOT NULL AND admfname3 IS NOT NULL AND admfname3 <> ''), "top_names" AS (SELECT first_name FROM "school_administrators" GROUP BY first_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cdscode) DESC, first_name ASC LIMIT 2) SELECT "d".district, "n".first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".cdscode) AS "school_count" FROM "districts" AS "d" CROSS JOIN "top_names" AS "n" LEFT JOIN "school_administrators" AS "a" ON "a".county = "d".county AND "a".district = "d".district AND "a".first_name = "n".first_name GROUP BY "d".county, "d".district, "n".first_name ORDER BY "d".district ASC, "n".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("sat".numtsttakr, 0)), 2) AS "average_sat_test_takers" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "s".county = 'Los Angeles' AND "s".opendate >= DATE '2007-01-01' AND "s".opendate < DATE '2008-01-01' AND "s".doctype IN ('County Office of Education (COE)', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".fundingtype, COUNT(*) AS "charter_school_count", SUM("f"."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "total_k12_enrollment", ROUND(AVG("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)")::NUMERIC * 100, 2) AS "average_frpm_percentage", ROUND(AVG("sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_combined_sat_score" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "s".statustype = 'Active' AND "s".charter = 1 AND "s".fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') GROUP BY "s".fundingtype LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "school_count" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500 AND "f"."High Grade" IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8') AND "s".school IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".school) <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "satscores" AS "sat" WHERE "sat".cds = "f".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' AND "sat".numtsttakr > 0) LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".district, "s".county, "t".avgscrwrite FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "t" ON "t".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".statustype = 'Closed' AND "t".rtype = 'S' AND "t".avgscrwrite = (SELECT MAX("t2".avgscrwrite) FROM "schools" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "t2" ON "t2".cds = "s2".cdscode WHERE "s2".statustype = 'Closed' AND "t2".rtype = 'S' AND "t2".avgscrwrite < (SELECT MAX("t3".avgscrwrite) FROM "schools" AS "s3" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "t3" ON "t3".cds = "s3".cdscode WHERE "s3".statustype = 'Closed' AND "t3".rtype = 'S')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "s".statustype = 'Active' AND "s".eilname = 'High School' AND COALESCE("sat".numtsttakr, 0) = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."County Name" AS "county_name", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_schools", ROUND(AVG(ROUND("f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC * 100 / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 0), 2)), 2) AS "average_free_meal_percentage", ROUND(AVG(ROUND("f"."FRPM Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC * 100 / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 0), 2)), 2) AS "average_frpm_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1) AS "number_of_charter_schools", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0) AS "number_of_non_charter_schools", ROUND(AVG("s".avgscrread + "s".avgscrmath + "s".avgscrwrite), 2) AS "average_sat_score" FROM "frpm" AS "f" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "s".cds = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."County Name" = (SELECT county FROM "schools" WHERE cdscode = '01612590125716') AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700 GROUP BY "f"."County Name" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / 12 AS "average_schools_per_month" FROM "schools" WHERE county = 'San Diego' AND doctype IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District') AND school IS NOT NULL AND opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND opendate < DATE '1981-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s".virtual IN ('F', 'P')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "sat".rtype = 'S' AND "sat".avgscrmath > 400 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".county, "s".district, "s".city, "f"."Enrollment (K-12)", "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)", "f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", "a".numtsttakr, "a".avgscrread, "a".avgscrmath, "a".avgscrwrite, "a".numge1500 FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "a" ON "a".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".cdscode = '01612590137943' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school AS "school_name", ROUND("f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / "f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 4) AS "free_meal_rate", CASE "s".charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "charter_school", "s".gsserved AS "grades_served", CASE WHEN "sat".avgscrread IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrmath IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS "sat_performance_level" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county = 'Alameda' AND ("s".gsserved = '12' OR "s".gsserved LIKE '%-12') AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0 AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / "f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("f2"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / NULLIF("f2"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 0)) FROM "schools" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f2" ON "f2".cdscode = "s2".cdscode WHERE "s2".county = 'Alameda' AND ("s2".gsserved = '12' OR "s2".gsserved LIKE '%-12') AND "f2"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0) LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".phone, "s".website, "sat".avgscrread, "sat".avgscrmath, "sat".avgscrwrite, ("s".charter = 1) AS "is_charter", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)", ROUND(("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "frpm_percentage", (SELECT MAX("sat2".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "sat2" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s2" ON "s2".cdscode = "sat2".cds WHERE "s2".statustype = 'Active' AND "sat2".rtype = 'S' AND "sat2".numtsttakr >= 10) AS "highest_average_sat_math", (SELECT MAX("sat2".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "sat2" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s2" ON "s2".cdscode = "sat2".cds WHERE "s2".statustype = 'Active' AND "sat2".rtype = 'S' AND "sat2".numtsttakr >= 10) - "sat".avgscrmath AS "math_score_gap" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' WHERE "s".cdscode = '07618040113118' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".county, "c".virtual_school_count, COALESCE("s".school, 'None') AS "school_name" FROM (SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS "virtual_school_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "county_rank" FROM "schools" WHERE virtual = 'F' GROUP BY county) AS "c" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "v".county, "v".school, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "v".county ORDER BY "sat".avgscrread DESC) AS "school_rank" FROM "schools" AS "v" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "v".cdscode WHERE "v".virtual = 'F' AND "sat".avgscrread IS NOT NULL) AS "s" ON "s".county = "c".county AND "s".school_rank = 1 WHERE "c".county_rank <= 5 ORDER BY "c".virtual_school_count DESC, "c".county ASC, "s".school ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".county, COUNT("s".cdscode) AS "exclusive_virtual_schools" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT county FROM "schools" WHERE county = 'Santa Barbara' OR cdscode = '1100170109835') AS "c" LEFT JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".county = "c".county AND "s".virtual = 'F' GROUP BY "c".county ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_schools DESC, "c".county ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT chosen.part, s.school, s.county, s.city, s.mailstreet, s.mailcity, s.mailstate, s.mailzip, s.website, f."Enrollment (K-12)", f."FRPM Count (K-12)", f."FRPM Count (K-12)"::numeric / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)"::numeric, 0) AS frpm_share, sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite AS average_total_sat_score, 100.0 * sat.numge1500 / NULLIF(sat.numtsttakr, 0) AS percentage_scoring_1500_or_more, s.opendate, CASE WHEN s.closeddate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status FROM (SELECT s1.cdscode, 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, 1 AS part_order FROM schools s1 JOIN frpm f1 ON f1.cdscode = s1.cdscode WHERE s1.edopscode = 'TRAD' AND s1.charter = 0 AND f1."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100 AND f1."FRPM Count (K-12)" = (SELECT MAX(f2."FRPM Count (K-12)") FROM schools s2 JOIN frpm f2 ON f2.cdscode = s2.cdscode WHERE s2.edopscode = 'TRAD' AND s2.charter = 0 AND f2."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100) UNION ALL SELECT s1.cdscode, 'smallest FRPM share' AS part, 2 AS part_order FROM schools s1 JOIN frpm f1 ON f1.cdscode = s1.cdscode WHERE s1.edopscode = 'TRAD' AND s1.charter = 0 AND f1."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100 AND f1."FRPM Count (K-12)"::numeric / NULLIF(f1."Enrollment (K-12)"::numeric, 0) = (SELECT MIN(f2."FRPM Count (K-12)"::numeric / NULLIF(f2."Enrollment (K-12)"::numeric, 0)) FROM schools s2 JOIN frpm f2 ON f2.cdscode = s2.cdscode WHERE s2.edopscode = 'TRAD' AND s2.charter = 0 AND f2."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100) UNION ALL SELECT s1.cdscode, 'the CDS code from my notes' AS part, 3 AS part_order FROM schools s1 JOIN frpm f1 ON f1.cdscode = s1.cdscode WHERE s1.edopscode = 'TRAD' AND s1.charter = 0 AND f1."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100 AND s1.cdscode = '4615150435602') AS chosen JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = chosen.cdscode JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = chosen.cdscode LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = chosen.cdscode AND sat.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY chosen.part_order, s.school, s.cdscode

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height), 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT player_api_id, defensive_work_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "player_attributes" WHERE defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')) AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id AND "a".rn = 1 WHERE "p".birthday >= '1990-01-01' AND "p".birthday < '1996-01-01' AND "a".defensive_work_rate = 'medium' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "ta".buildupplaydribblingclass FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "ta".team_api_id INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".home_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id OR "m".away_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "m".country_id WHERE "t".team_short_name = 'POR' AND "c".name = 'England' AND "ta".date >= '2015-09-10' AND "ta".date < '2015-09-11' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".season, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "number_of_players" FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "m".home_team_goal - "m".away_team_goal >= 5 GROUP BY "m".season ORDER BY "m".season ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "player_count" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT player_api_id, volleys, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "player_attributes") AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id AND "pa".rn = 1 WHERE "p".height > 180 AND "pa".volleys > 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("t".total_goals, 0)), 2) AS "average_total_home_goals" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT home_player_3, SUM(home_team_goal) AS "total_goals" FROM "match" GROUP BY home_player_3) AS "t" ON "t".home_player_3 = "p".player_api_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name FROM "country" AS "c" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".country_id = "c".id LEFT JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) AND "p".weight <= 160 GROUP BY "c".id, "c".name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) = (SELECT MIN("q".player_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p2".player_api_id) AS "player_count" FROM "match" AS "m2" LEFT JOIN "player" AS "p2" ON "p2".player_api_id IN ("m2".home_player_1, "m2".home_player_2, "m2".home_player_3, "m2".home_player_4, "m2".home_player_5, "m2".home_player_6, "m2".home_player_7, "m2".home_player_8, "m2".home_player_9, "m2".home_player_10, "m2".home_player_11, "m2".away_player_1, "m2".away_player_2, "m2".away_player_3, "m2".away_player_4, "m2".away_player_5, "m2".away_player_6, "m2".away_player_7, "m2".away_player_8, "m2".away_player_9, "m2".away_player_10, "m2".away_player_11) AND "p2".weight <= 160 GROUP BY "m2".country_id) AS "q") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "player_count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date::TIMESTAMP < TIMESTAMP '2015-01-02 00:00:00' ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC, id DESC) AS "latest" WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "current_attributes".attacking_work_rate = 'low') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "current_attributes" WHERE "current_attributes".preferred_foot = 'left' AND "current_attributes".attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS "player_count" FROM "player_attributes" WHERE jumping >= 80 AND date >= '2007-02-22' AND date < '2007-08-31' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN "p".player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN "current_ratings".overall_rating END) - AVG("current_ratings".overall_rating)) / NULLIF(AVG("current_ratings".overall_rating), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, overall_rating, defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date::TIMESTAMP < TIMESTAMP '2013-07-13' ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date::TIMESTAMP DESC, id DESC) AS "current_ratings" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "current_ratings".player_api_id WHERE "current_ratings".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".account_id, (SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) FROM "district") AS "salary_difference" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".client_id = "c".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM "district" WHERE a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district")) AND "c".birth_date = (SELECT MIN("c2".birth_date) FROM "client" AS "c2" WHERE "c2".gender = 'F' AND "c2".district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM "district" WHERE a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district"))) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "di".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date = DATE '1976-01-29' AND "di".type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".gender = 'M') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "male_percentage" FROM "client" AS "c" WHERE "c".district_id = (SELECT "d".district_id FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'south Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT ("t2".balance - "t1".balance)::NUMERIC * 100 / NULLIF("t1".balance, 0) AS "percentage_increase" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t1" ON "t1".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t1".date = DATE '1993-03-22' INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t2" ON "t2".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t2".date = DATE '1998-12-27' WHERE "l".date = DATE '1993-07-05' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".frequency FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '2001-01-01' AND "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".a2 AS "district", ROUND((("d".a13::NUMERIC - "d".a12::NUMERIC) / NULLIF("d".a12::NUMERIC, 0)) * 100, 2) AS "unemployment_rate_percentage_change" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a12 IS NOT NULL AND "d".a13 IS NOT NULL AND "l".status = 'D' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".account_id) AS "number_of_accounts" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "r" ON "r".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".type <> 'OWNER' AND "r".a11 > 8000 AND "r".a11 <= 9000 GROUP BY "d".type LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "percentage_growth" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M') AS "male_accounts" ON "male_accounts".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".account_id = 3 AND "o".amount = 3539 LIMIT 501

SELECT district, population FROM (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "a".date >= (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN("a2".date)) FROM "account" AS "a2") AND "a".date < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN("a2".date)) + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM "account" AS "a2") GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a4) AS "ranked" WHERE population_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE ("t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '') AND "t".account_id IN (SELECT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM("l".active_loan_amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT("a".account_id), 0)) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM (SELECT district_id, a2 FROM "district" ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC LIMIT 5) AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "active_loan_amount" FROM "loan" WHERE status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("l".active_loan_amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT("a".account_id), 0) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 501

SELECT region, total FROM (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", SUM("l".amount) AS "total", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("l".amount) DESC) AS "ranking" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date + "l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month' > DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY "d".a3) AS "ranked" WHERE ranking = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("t".a11), 2) AS "average_salary", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a11 FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') AS "t" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "account_disp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "account_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id) AS "card_accounts" ON "card_accounts".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id WHERE "card_accounts".account_id IS NULL) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "a".account_id, COUNT("l".loan_id) AS "loan_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id) AS "account_loans" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE TRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') AS "cohort" ON "cohort".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".amount > 4000 AND "t".type IN ('VYBER', 'VYDAJ') LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id AS "account_number", "a".date AS "account_opening_date", "l".total_borrowed, COALESCE("t".counterparties, 0) AS "outside_bank_counterparties", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", CAST("home".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST("home".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC NULLS LAST) AS "population_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS "counterparties" FROM "trans" WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND bank IS NOT NULL AND bank <> '' GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' ORDER BY CAST("home".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC NULLS LAST, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".gender, "s".district_count, "s".district_name, "s".inhabitants, "s".average_salary, "s".average_urban_ratio FROM (SELECT "q".gender, "q".district_name, "q".inhabitants, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("q".salary) OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender), 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(AVG("q".urban_ratio::NUMERIC) OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender), 2) AS "average_urban_ratio", MAX("q".inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender) AS "max_inhabitants" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a10 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "cd" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "card_disp" ON "card_disp".disp_id = "cd".disp_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "card_disp".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "cd".type = 'gold' AND "d".a4::BIGINT > 100000) AS "q") AS "s" WHERE "s".inhabitants = "s".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, "s".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT bank AS "recipient_bank_code", account AS "recipient_counter_account", number_of_outgoing_payments, total_amount_paid FROM (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("t".amount) DESC) AS "ranking" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "dp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'gold') AS "gold_accounts" ON "gold_accounts".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".date >= '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < '1999-01-01' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) >= 250000 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account) AS "ranked" WHERE ranking = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND NULLIF(TRIM("t".k_symbol), '') IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG(unemployment)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_district_unemployment_rate", (ARRAY_AGG(district_name ORDER BY population DESC NULLS LAST, district_name ASC))[1] AS "most_populous_district" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a12 AS "unemployment" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "p".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "p".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "p".type = 'OWNER') AS "eligible_districts" GROUP BY region ORDER BY region ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT a2 AS "district_name", a16 AS "crimes_1996", ROUND(AVG(a16) OVER (), 2) AS "top_three_average_crimes_1996", ROUND((SELECT AVG(a16) FROM "district"), 2) AS "overall_average_crimes_1996", ROUND(AVG(a16) OVER () - (SELECT AVG(a16) FROM "district"), 2) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT a2, a4, a16 FROM "district" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, LOWER(TRANSLATE(a2, 'ÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽáčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'ACDEEINORSTUUYZacdeeinorstuuyz')) ASC LIMIT 3) AS "top_districts" ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, LOWER(TRANSLATE(a2, 'ÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽáčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'ACDEEINORSTUUYZacdeeinorstuuyz')) ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT type, district, inhabitants FROM (SELECT "c".type, "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4 AS "inhabitants", DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "c".type ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT ASC) AS "rnk" FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".disp_id = "c".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "p".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id WHERE "c".type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior') AND "d".a4 IS NOT NULL) AS "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 GROUP BY type, district, inhabitants ORDER BY type ASC, district ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened_1996", ROUND(AVG((SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1)), 2) AS "average_end_of_1996_balance", ROUND(SUM(SUM((SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1))) OVER () / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT((SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1))) OVER (), 0), 2) AS "region_wide_average_end_of_1996_balance", FIRST_VALUE("d".a2) OVER (ORDER BY AVG((SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1)) DESC NULLS LAST, "d".a2 ASC) AS "district_with_highest_average_balance" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice') GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4 AS "inhabitants", ROUND((SELECT AVG("d2".a11)::NUMERIC FROM "district" AS "d2" WHERE "d2".district_id IN (SELECT "a2".district_id FROM (SELECT "l".account_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10) AS "top_loans" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".account_id = "top_loans".account_id)), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".district_id IN (SELECT "a2".district_id FROM (SELECT "l".account_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10) AS "top_loans" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".account_id = "top_loans".account_id) ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC, "d".district_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4 AS "population", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn", ROUND(SUM("t".amount) / CAST("d".a4 AS NUMERIC), 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("t".amount) / CAST("d".a4 AS NUMERIC) DESC) AS "district_rank", ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CAST("o".amount AS NUMERIC)) FROM "account" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a2".account_id WHERE "a2".district_id = "d".district_id), 0) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "account" AS "a3" WHERE "a3".district_id = "d".district_id), 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE CAST("d".a4 AS NUMERIC) >= 100000 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4 ORDER BY district_rank ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opened", "a".frequency, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "a".district_id = "c".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "home_district", "d".a11 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", COALESCE("rc".client_count, 0) AS "region_client_count", "d".most_populous_district, "d".most_populous_inhabitants, "d".population_rank FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT district_id, a2, a3, a11, FIRST_VALUE(a2) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST, district_id ASC) AS "most_populous_district", FIRST_VALUE(a4::BIGINT) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST, district_id ASC) AS "most_populous_inhabitants", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST) AS "population_rank" FROM "district") AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "d2".a3, COUNT(*) AS "client_count" FROM "client" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "c2".district_id GROUP BY "d2".a3) AS "rc" ON "rc".a3 = "d".a3 WHERE "c".client_id = 3541 ORDER BY COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR("district_year".account_year, 'YYYY') AS "account_opening_year", SUM("district_year".account_count) AS "accounts_opened", SUM("district_year".amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG("district_year".amount_lent / "district_year".account_count::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', "a".date) AS "account_year", "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count", SUM(COALESCE("l".amount_lent, 0)) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "amount_lent" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('year', "a".date), "a".district_id) AS "district_year" GROUP BY "district_year".account_year ORDER BY "district_year".account_year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "l".amount AS "approved_amount", "l".date AS "approval_date", (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t".date <= "l".date ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "account_balance" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) AS "age_at_card_issue", COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("l".total_amount, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'Non-borrower' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' ELSE 'Mature borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "c".gender ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) DESC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "di".client_id LEFT JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "di".account_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01' ORDER BY "c".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1998-10-15' AND ("t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '') WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank AS "bank_code", "t".account AS "account_number", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".amount = 98832 AND "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount ELSE -"t".amount END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM "disp" WHERE client_id = 2823) AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

SELECT "q".client_id, ROUND("q".amount::NUMERIC, 2) AS "loan_amount", "q".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND("q".payments::NUMERIC * "q".duration, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND("q".payments::NUMERIC * "q".duration - "q".amount, 2) AS "interest_paid", "q".status AS "loan_status", "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", ROUND(COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > 2::NUMERIC * "q".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > "q".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "r".loan_count AS "region_loan_count", "s".average_salary AS "region_average_salary", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "q".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM (SELECT "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".account_id = "l".account_id AND "di".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "di".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F') AS "q" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "q".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "q".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "d2".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".account_id = "l2".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "a2".district_id GROUP BY "d2".a3) AS "r" ON "r".region = "d".a3 INNER JOIN (SELECT a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG(a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) AS "s" ON "s".region = "d".a3 WHERE "q".loan_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "q".amount DESC, "q".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", SUM("d".a4::BIGINT) AS "combined_population", SUM("q".account_count) AS "account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".duration > 24 GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "q" ON "q".district_id = "d".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3 ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM("d".account_count) AS "total_accounts", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT "district".district_id, "district".a11, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "district" INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".district_id = "district".district_id WHERE "district".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 AND "account".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "account".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "account".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "district".district_id, "district".a11) AS "d" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".total_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("t".total_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("t".counterparty_count, 0) AS "number_of_external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("t".counterparty_count, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "di".account_id FROM "disp" AS "di" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "di".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold') AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_received", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT (bank, account)) FILTER (WHERE bank IS NOT NULL AND bank <> '' AND account IS NOT NULL AND operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')) AS "counterparty_count" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id ORDER BY rank ASC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "c".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "c".birth_date)) AS "owner_age", COALESCE("cards".card_count, 0) AS "card_count", COALESCE("loans".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN COALESCE("loans".loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan' WHEN "loans".has_default THEN 'defaulted' WHEN "loans".has_repaying THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS "loan_standing", COALESCE("activity".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("activity".money_in, 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE("activity".money_out, 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE("activity".peak_balance, 0) AS "peak_balance", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("activity".peak_balance, 0) DESC) AS "peak_balance_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "di".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "card_count" FROM "disp" AS "di" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "di".disp_id WHERE "ca".issued < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "di".account_id) AS "cards" ON "cards".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", BOOL_OR(status = 'B') AS "has_default", BOOL_OR(status IN ('C', 'D')) AS "has_repaying" FROM "loan" WHERE date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) AS "loans" ON "loans".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_in", SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_out", MAX(balance) AS "peak_balance" FROM "trans" WHERE SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 LIKE '%:%' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q2 LIKE '%:%' AND "q2".q2 > (SELECT MIN("q3".q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q3" WHERE "q3".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q3".q2 LIKE '%:%')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "number_of_drivers" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "r".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND CASE WHEN "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-5][0-9]([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC > 120 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "p2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name", "d".nationality, "r".name AS "first_win_race", "r".date AS "first_win_date", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "results" AS "career" INNER JOIN "races" AS "cr" ON "cr".raceid = "career".raceid WHERE "career".driverid = "d".driverid AND "cr".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 AND "career".grid > 0) AS "races_started" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "win" ON "win".driverid = "d".driverid AND "win".position = 1 INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "win".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "d".dob ASC, "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname ASC, "r".date ASC, "r".name ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name AS "constructor_name" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "q".raceid AND "res".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{3}$' ORDER BY split_part("q".q2, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + replace(split_part("q".q2, ':', 2), '.', '')::INTEGER ASC, "res".grid ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "q2".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?$' AND split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 LIKE '%:%' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 LIKE '%:%') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "res".time AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position = 2 WHERE "r".raceid = (SELECT raceid FROM "races" WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time ASC, year DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 LIKE '%:%' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position = 1 INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC) < 98 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "earliest_circuit".circuitref AS "earliest_circuit_reference", "latest_circuit".circuitref AS "latest_circuit_reference", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("latest_race".time::TIME - "earliest_race".time::TIME)) AS "gap_seconds" FROM "races" AS "earliest_race" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "earliest_circuit" ON "earliest_circuit".circuitid = "earliest_race".circuitid CROSS JOIN "races" AS "latest_race" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "latest_circuit" ON "latest_circuit".circuitid = "latest_race".circuitid WHERE "earliest_race".time IS NOT NULL AND "latest_race".time IS NOT NULL AND "earliest_race".time::TIME = (SELECT MIN("r".time::TIME) FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL) AND "latest_race".time::TIME = (SELECT MAX("r".time::TIME) FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND "r".fastestlapspeed ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob ORDER BY MAX(CAST("r".fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC)) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR "q".q2 = '') ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC NULLS FIRST, "q".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) AS "drivers_withdrew" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".year = 1962 AND "r".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "s".status = 'Finished' OR "s".status ~ '^[+][0-9]+ Laps?$' THEN "res".driverid END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".year = 1957 AND "r".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total::NUMERIC), 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("e".cost) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "e".expense_date::DATE) IN (9, 10) GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_expenses" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "difference" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN "b".amount END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN "b".amount END), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e".event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".amount) <> 0 AND SUM("b".spent)::NUMERIC / SUM("b".amount) = (SELECT MAX("r".ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM("b2".spent)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM("b2".amount), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e2".event_id) AS "r") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "expense" WHERE cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense")) AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "soccer".attendance AS "soccer_attendance", "fall".average_attendance, CASE WHEN "soccer".attendance > "fall".average_attendance THEN 'more' WHEN "soccer".attendance < "fall".average_attendance THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendance" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "soccer" CROSS JOIN (SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_attendance".attendance), 1) AS "average_attendance" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendance" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance") AS "fall" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".department, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".major_id) AS "majors_offered", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".member_id IS NOT NULL THEN "d".major_id END) AS "majors_held", ROUND(COUNT("m".member_id)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "d".major_id), 0), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "major" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS "c" ON "c".department = "d".department LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "d".major_id GROUP BY "d".department ORDER BY "d".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_type", COALESCE(SUM("a".attendee_count), 0) AS "members_attended", COALESCE(SUM("b".budgeted_amount), 0) AS "total_budgeted_dollars" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "budgeted_amount" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".department, COALESCE((SELECT SUM("i".amount) FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "i".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "mm" ON "mm".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' AND "m".position = 'Member' AND "m".member_id IN (SELECT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a") AND "mm".department = "d".department AND "mm".college IN (SELECT college FROM "major" WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department')), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college IN (SELECT college FROM "major" WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department')) AS "d" LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game') AS "attendees" ON "attendees".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "major" AS "ma" WHERE "ma".college IN (SELECT "tyler_major".college FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "tyler_major" ON "tyler_major".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "m".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "m".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "major" AS "same_name_major" INNER JOIN "member" AS "enrolled" ON "enrolled".link_to_major = "same_name_major".major_id WHERE "same_name_major".college = "ma".college AND "same_name_major".major_name = "ma".major_name) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_attendance".member_count), 2) AS "average_attendance" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE category = 'Advertisement') AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' AND "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "m".major_id = "mem".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m".major_id, "m".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "mem2" ON "mem2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "m2".major_id = "mem2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m2".major_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY "m".major_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m".link_to_major = "major".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_count) FILTER (WHERE position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')), 2) AS "average_events_per_officer", ROUND(AVG(event_count) FILTER (WHERE position NOT IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') OR position IS NULL), 2) AS "average_events_per_other_student" FROM (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) AS "member_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', "n".n)))) AS "count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0) AS "ob" ON "ob".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS "n" WHERE "n".n <= 1 + LENGTH("e".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("e".expense_description, ',', '')) LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_cost, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2) AS "water_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "water_cost" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "college_department".department IS NOT NULL) AS "in_college", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "college_department".department IS NULL) AS "not_in_college" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "member_major" ON "m".link_to_major = "member_major".major_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS "college_department" ON "member_major".department = "college_department".department LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "cb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "cb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "cb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x".cost > 0) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING MAX("b".amount) = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "cb2".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "cb2" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x2" ON "x2".link_to_budget = "cb2".budget_id WHERE "x2".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x2".cost > 0) AS "eligible2" ON "eligible2".link_to_event = "b2".link_to_event) LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_date, SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" WHERE "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("vp_expense".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "vp_expense" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "vp_expense".link_to_member WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President') GROUP BY "e".expense_date LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_category", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".college, "g".number_of_majors FROM (SELECT "ma".college, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "ma".college) AS "g" WHERE "g".number_of_majors = (SELECT MAX("c".number_of_majors) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "ma".college) AS "c") ORDER BY "g".college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "qualifying_budget" ON "qualifying_budget".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "qualifying_budget".amount > 40 INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_amount_budgeted" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "pb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "pb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "pb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "pizza_events" ON "pizza_events".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING COALESCE((SELECT SUM("b2".spent) FROM "budget" AS "b2" WHERE "b2".link_to_event = "e".event_id), 0) <= COALESCE((SELECT SUM("b3".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b3" WHERE "b3".link_to_event = "e".event_id), 0) ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "x".expense_description IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("x".expense_description) <> '' THEN LENGTH("x".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("x".expense_description, ',', '')) + 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) DESC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "t".type, "t".number_of_members FROM (SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) DESC) AS "ranking" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type) AS "t" WHERE "t".ranking = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT TRIM(split_part("ex".expense_description, ',', "n".position)) AS "item_name", "b".category, SUM("ex".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "ex" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "position" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) AS "n" ON "n".position <= 1 + LENGTH("ex".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("ex".expense_description, ',', '')) WHERE "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "ex".approved = 'true' GROUP BY TRIM(split_part("ex".expense_description, ',', "n".position)), "b".category ORDER BY "b".category ASC, item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE("b".total_budgeted, 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COALESCE("a".member_count, 0) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT lower(TRIM(split_part(replace("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', "n".n))) AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS "n" WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' AND TRIM(split_part(replace("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', "n".n)) <> '' GROUP BY lower(TRIM(split_part(replace("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', "n".n))) ORDER BY item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT full_name, kind_count, total_spending FROM (SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n))) <> 'parking' THEN NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(split_part("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n))), '') END) AS "kind_count", SUM(CASE WHEN "n".n = 1 THEN "e".cost::NUMERIC ELSE 0 END) AS "total_spending", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n))) <> 'parking' THEN NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(split_part("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n))), '') END) DESC) AS "kind_rank" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "e".link_to_member CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS "n") AS "n" WHERE "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name) AS "ranked" WHERE kind_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_name) AS "number_of_different_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id WHERE "ma".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour, COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour IS NOT NULL AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "c".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".publisher_name, COUNT("s".id) - (SELECT COUNT("s2".id) FROM "publisher" AS "p2" LEFT JOIN "superhero" AS "s2" ON "s2".publisher_id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') AND "p2".id <> "p".id) AS "difference" FROM "publisher" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY "p".id, "p".publisher_name HAVING COUNT("s".id) = (SELECT MAX("counts".hero_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT("s3".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "publisher" AS "p3" LEFT JOIN "superhero" AS "s3" ON "s3".publisher_id = "p3".id WHERE "p3".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY "p3".id) AS "counts") LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) NOT IN ('', '-', 'N/A') AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "c".colour, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "h" ON "h".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "sk" ON "sk".id = "s".skin_colour_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "c".colour = "h".colour AND "c".colour = "sk".colour AND "c".colour IS NOT NULL AND "c".colour NOT IN ('No Colour', '-', 'N/A') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("m".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "m" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "mp".id = "m".publisher_id WHERE "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "m".height_cm > 0 AND "m".id IN (SELECT "mhp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "mhp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "dhp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "dhp" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "d" ON "d".id = "dhp".hero_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "d".publisher_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc_powers" ON "dc_powers".power_id = "mhp".power_id WHERE "dc_powers".power_id IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "strength_hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "strength_hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "strength" ON "strength".id = "strength_hp".power_id WHERE "strength".power_name = 'Super Strength') AS "strength_heroes" ON "strength_heroes".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT("strength_heroes".hero_id)) AS "qualifying_powers" LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') OR "a".alignment IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) DESC) AS "power_rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' GROUP BY "sp".id, "sp".power_name) AS "ranked" WHERE power_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "ab_ha".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ab_ha" ON "ab_ha".hero_id = "ab".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "ab_a" ON "ab_a".id = "ab_ha".attribute_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "ab_a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT("s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id AND "s".hair_colour_id = (SELECT "c".id FROM "colour" AS "c" WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "s".id) >= 10 WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".id, "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::BIGINT AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "hha".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hha" ON "hha".hero_id = "h".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "hat" ON "hat".id = "hha".attribute_id WHERE "h".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "hat".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM (SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL AND height_cm > 0) AS "tallest" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "tallest".id WHERE "tallest".height_rank <= 10 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "character_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') AND ("s".race_id IS NULL OR "r".race = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("power_counts".power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "power_counts" LIMIT 501
