SELECT ROUND(AVG("portfolio".power_count), 1) AS "average_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "shared".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "shared" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo_hero" ON "cryo_hero".power_id = "shared".power_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo_power" ON "cryo_power".hero_id = "cryo_hero".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "cryo_power".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis') AS "matching" ON "matching".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "portfolio" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg > 0 AND "dc".eye_colour_id IN (SELECT "marvel".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "mp".id = "marvel".publisher_id WHERE "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "h" WHERE "h".height_cm > 0 AND "h".race_id IN (SELECT "a".race_id FROM "superhero" AS "a" WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".race_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "superhero" AS "f" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "f".gender_id WHERE "f".race_id = "s".race_id AND "g".gender = 'Female') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "publisher" AS "p" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" WHERE "h".publisher_id IN (SELECT "b".publisher_id FROM "superhero" AS "b" WHERE "b".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf') AND "h".eye_colour_id IN (SELECT "other".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "other" WHERE "other".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "other".publisher_id NOT IN (SELECT "b".publisher_id FROM "superhero" AS "b" WHERE "b".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' AND "b".publisher_id IS NOT NULL)) LIMIT 501

SELECT race, superhero_count FROM (SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "race_rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT "c".publisher_id FROM "superhero" AS "c" WHERE "c".full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AND "r".race IS NOT NULL AND "r".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r".id, "r".race) AS "ranked" WHERE race_rank = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value), 1) AS "average_intelligence" FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "ha".hero_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("p".power_count, 0)), 2) AS "average_superpowers" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND TRIM("s".full_name) ~ '[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]''.-]*[[:space:]]+[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]''.-]*' GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "s".height_cm > 0 THEN "s".height_cm END), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "s".weight_kg > 0 THEN "s".weight_kg END), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, -99)), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, -99)), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "h" WHERE "h".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "h".height_cm > 0 AND "h".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".power_name = 'Flight') AS "f" ON "f".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm > 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "largest_number_of_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "h".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "h".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "h".weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg > 0) GROUP BY "h".id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) NOT IN ('-', 'N/A') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM("s".full_name)) NOT IN ('-', 'n/a', 'unknown', 'bizarro', 'krypto the superdog', 'mr. mxyzptlk') LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour <> 'Brown') AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "eye".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "s".hair_colour_id GROUP BY "eye".id, "eye".colour HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour = 'Brown') > 0 ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "eye".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND NULLIF(TRIM("s".full_name), '') IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) NOT IN ('-', 'N/A', 'Unknown') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "h" WHERE "h".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "h".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "h".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0 THEN "p".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5 THEN "p".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".hct >= 52) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_female" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE pt >= 14) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '2026-10-09' - INTERVAL '55 years' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".description IS NULL AND "l".crp LIKE '%+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission LIKE '+%') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l"."date", "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp = '256' AND "l"."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-BIL") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".rnp = '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 10 ELSE FALSE END) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "l".rnp::BIGINT AS "anti-RNP titer" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::BIGINT = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "r".rnp::BIGINT END) FROM "laboratory" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "r".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AS "s2" ON "s2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lp" ON "lp".id = "p".id AND "lp".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lr" ON "lr".id = "p".id AND "lr".rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND "e".diagnosis IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("e".diagnosis) <> '' AND TRIM("e".diagnosis) <> 'MCTD' WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".test_dates, 0)), 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "test_dates" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".sex = 'F' AND "p2".admission = '+' AND "l2".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') ORDER BY "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 16 ELSE FALSE END GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id AND ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id AND "r".rnp IN ('64', '256') LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS BIGINT)) AS "highest_anti_rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "normal".id IS NOT NULL) AS "had_normal_platelet", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "normal".id IS NULL) AS "never_had_normal_platelet" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt > 100 AND plt < 400) AS "normal" ON "normal".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '^[[:space:]]*([^,]+[[:space:]]+susp[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*)*(RA[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*([^,]+[[:space:]]+susp[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*)*SJS|SJS[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*([^,]+[[:space:]]+susp[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*)*RA)([[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*[^,]+[[:space:]]+susp)*[[:space:]]*$' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp::NUMERIC - 8.5), 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND diagnosis !~* 'SLE[[:space:]]+susp') AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE elevated) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "p".id, BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 64 ELSE FALSE END) AS "elevated" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND ("l".rnp = 'negative' OR "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') GROUP BY "p".id) AS "tested" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 32 ELSE FALSE END GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l"."date") - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) >= 64 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "e".symptoms <> '' AND "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|,)[[:space:]]*SLE([[:space:]]*[(][^)]*[)])?[[:space:]]*(,|$)' GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(first_examination_date - "First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p"."First Date", MIN("e"."Examination Date") AS "first_examination_date" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p"."First Date") AS "patient_first_examinations" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l"."un" < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_with_high_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) / COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cre >= 1.5 WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".admission, "p".id, "l"."T-CHO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = "p".admission) ORDER BY "p".admission ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "l".rnp AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".rnp AS INTEGER)) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p2"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l2".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501
SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') AND hct IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id") FILTER (WHERE "p"."admission" IN ('+', '+(')) AS "admitted", COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id") FILTER (WHERE "p"."admission" = '-') AS "outpatient" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."diagnosis" = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+') WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_sample_date", MAX(CASE WHEN sc170 IS NOT NULL THEN date END) AS "latest_sc170_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "l".id AND "latest".latest_sc170_date = "l".date WHERE "latest".latest_sample_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id WHERE "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM("s".ssa)) NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "u"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM("u"."U-PRO")) NOT IN ('negative', 'none', '-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND CASE WHEN "l".dna ~ '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$' THEN CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) < 8 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST(rnp AS INTEGER) END) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE cre < 1.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(rnp AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS NUMERIC)) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "eligibility_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".ldh < 500 WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_results", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX(CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER)) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE hgb < 10) AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex HAVING MAX(CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER)) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".rnp AS INTEGER)) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE hgb < 10) AS "anemia2" ON "anemia2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-' AND "l2".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MIN("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id) AND "l".got < 60 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 10 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id AND "l2"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN 0 ELSE "l".rnp::INTEGER END > 4 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday ORDER BY MAX("l".gpt) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) >= 16 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l"."date", "p".birthday)) AS "age", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l"."date" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[,[:space:]])SLE([[:space:]]*[(][^)]*[)])?[[:space:]]*(,|$)' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".id IS NOT NULL THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".id IS NULL THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256') WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL AND date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "latest".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna AS "highest anti-DNA test result" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "l2".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "latest".igg > 900 AND "latest".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL AND date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC, igg DESC) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END)) AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) >= 32 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "l".id AND "latest".latest_date = "l".date WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp = '256' AND "l".cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '-') AS "outpatients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l1" ON "l1".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p".id WHERE "l1".ldh >= 500 AND "l2"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=1000', '>=300') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "e".symptoms <> '' AND "e".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "e".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]]|$)' ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "diagnosis" FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "admission" LIKE '+%' AND "birthday" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("First Date", "birthday")) DESC, "id" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "male_patients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') AS "female_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc < 3.5) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SJS([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SJS[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ~* '(^|,)[[:space:]]*SjS[[:space:]]*(,|$)' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id WHERE "s".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "u"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "p".id NOT IN (SELECT "e2".id FROM "examination" AS "e2" WHERE "e2".thrombosis <> 0 OR "e2".thrombosis IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "a" ON "a".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("r".rbc <= 3.5 OR "r".rbc >= 6.0) AND "a".rnp IN ('1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '2026-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 15 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday <= "l".date AND "l".date < "p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '30', '100', '300', '%%', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=1000', '>=300', 'TR') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'o' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_occurrences" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element IN ('i', 's') AND "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "p" ON "p".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' AND "p".element IN ('p', 'br') GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "fraction", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "b".molecule_id IS NULL THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END AS "molecule_group", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type <> '-' OR bond_type IS NULL) AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN "b".molecule_id IS NULL THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END ORDER BY molecule_group DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' LIMIT 501

SELECT element, ROUND(100.0 * total_atoms / all_atoms, 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "total_atoms", SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS "all_atoms", SUM(CASE WHEN "c".atom_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "bonded_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected" GROUP BY atom_id) AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "a".element) AS "counts" WHERE bonded_atoms = (SELECT MAX(bonded_atoms) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "bonded_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected" GROUP BY atom_id) AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "a".element) AS "bonded_counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#') GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "neighbor".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "sulfur" ON "sulfur".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "sulfur".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "neighbor" ON "neighbor".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "sulfur".element = 's' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN(molecule_id) AS "molecule_id" FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) AS "unique_elements" ON "unique_elements".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND "a".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT "a2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c2" ON "c2".atom_id = "a2".atom_id OR "c2".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b2" ON "b2".bond_id = "c2".bond_id WHERE "a2".element = 'n' AND "b2".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "carcinogenic_percent", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '-') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "non_carcinogenic_percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT element FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) AS "rare" ON "rare".element = "a".element LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC, "ac".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", "m".molecule_id, "m".label, "ac".atom_count, COALESCE("bc".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "ac".carbon_count, "ac".chlorine_count, COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bonds, 0) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id) AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT("cb".bond_id) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "bond" AS "b" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".bond_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".element = 'c') AS "cb" ON "cb".bond_id = "b".bond_id GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_count > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "h".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "y" ON "y".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "h".element = 'h' AND "y".element = 'y' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("atom_bonds".bond_count), 2) AS "average_bonds_per_atom" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT("s".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "a2".atom_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a2".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "a2".atom_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "b".bond_type = '-' THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) = 0) AS "s" ON "s".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element IN (SELECT "triple_atom".element FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "triple_atom" ON "triple_atom".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "b".bond_id IS NOT NULL THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = 'TR397' WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
